deck_title: Foucault-Coriolis omega = Omega*sin(phi) latitude sine precession & Gauss-Bonnet holonomy vs naive 24-hour polar precession rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Gaspard-Gustave de Coriolis (1835) & Léon Foucault (1851) rotating-sphere latitude sine precession and Gauss-Bonnet parallel-transport holonomy law (projecting planetary angular velocity Omega onto the local vertical normal as omega_F = Omega * sin(phi) = Omega / (1 + u), locking omega_active / omega_Foucault = 1.0000x across all 17 cosecant-latitude stations u = csc(phi) - 1 in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive latitude-invariant 24-hour polar precession shader (omega = Omega, which overestimates horizontal precession and Coriolis deflection by csc(phi) = 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-sector Gauss-Bonnet cone holonomy quadrature.
